summary: BW LPG Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing a routine quarterly update on its Product Services segment's Q2 2026 performance, including a gross trading loss of USD 19 million (realized gain of USD 127 million less unrealized mark-to-market loss of USD 146 million) and a net loss of USD 31 million. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is announced. The filing is a standard performance update ahead of the full Q2 2026 results release on 28 August 2026, with no board recommendation, advisors, or structural changes. This is not a special situation.
